Backend 15/15 PASS (test_iteration5.py) covering books search + ISBN (Google + Open Library fallback + 404), POST /api/books year field, clubs challenge PATCH/POST progress with 400/403 rules and leaderboard, stats/reading shape + effects (quote creation marks today active, PATCH progress_page increments week_pages). (D+E) profile shows reading-stats card (streak, 7 bars) AND real stats numbers (1 livre, 1 citation, 0 tableaux, 3 themes) — not zeros anymore, iter-4 regression is fixed. Dark mode toggle works: profile bg goes rgb(210,226,236) → rgb(45,25,19) (espresso), toggle-back restores light bg. Club challenge card renders on Club Candide with Objectif Candide 150p, updating challenge-my-pages to 90 immediately reflects on the leaderboard (90 p.). CRITICAL BUG DETECTED: navigating to /library throws Uncaught ReferenceError 'styles is not defined at BookCard' (screen text visibly shows the RN red-screen error overlay). This is a code-scope bug in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/library.tsx — the BookCard sub-component (declared OUTSIDE Library) references `styles.card`, `styles.cover`, etc. but `styles` is only created via `useStyles(makeStyles)` inside the Library component. Any book render crashes. This is NOT dark-mode specific — it will crash in LIGHT mode too as soon as there is ≥1 book to render. Since user has 1 Candide book, /library is broken today. Backend /api/books/search returns 0 results for 'alchimiste' from this container's IP because Google Books rate-limits (429) — endpoint code is correct; frontend correctly shows the title-empty message + manual-book fallback. ISBN fallback via Open Library works (verified: 9782070368228 → source=openlibrary).

minor.issue: From this container the Google Books API returns HTTP 429 (rate limit) → endpoint returns empty {results:[]}. Endpoint code is correct. No fallback to Open Library on the free-text search (only ISBN has fallback). Consider adding an Open Library search fallback for resilience in production too.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught ReferenceError: 'styles is not defined at BookCard'. BookCard is declared at module scope (line 33) but references styles.card/cover/coverInitial/badge/statusMeta/title/author/progressBar/progressFill/progressText/footer which are only created via useStyles(makeStyles) INSIDE the Library() component (line 68). Any book in the list crashes rendering. Applies in BOTH light and dark modes — the tester noticed it during dark-mode nav but it is not dark-specific. Fix: either move BookCard inside Library() so it closes over `styles`, or call `const styles = useStyles(makeStyles)` at the top of BookCard, or pass styles as prop. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/library.tsx:33-64

rca_of_issue: RCA — /library crash: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/library.tsx declares `function BookCard(...)` at module scope (line 33), but the `styles` object is created via `const styles = useStyles(makeStyles)` INSIDE the Library() function component (line 68). BookCard has no `styles` in its closure/lexical scope, so `styles.card` on line 40 throws ReferenceError. The `makeStyles(colors) => StyleSheet.create({...})` factory pattern was likely introduced during the light→dark refactor, replacing an old module-level `const styles = StyleSheet.create({...})` — during that refactor BookCard was not updated. Reproduction: open /library after logging in with any account that owns ≥1 book (e.g., Léa/Candide). Mitigation options: (1) Move `function BookCard(...)` INSIDE `export default function Library()` so it closes over the local `styles` (simplest, no prop-drilling). (2) At the top of BookCard, add `const styles = useStyles(makeStyles);`. (3) Pass `styles` as a prop from Library. Recommend option (1) — minimal diff, keeps the styles memoization at one call site.
